text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: And my favorite scene in this volume iswhen the protagonist faces the enemychampion in a gallant duel. It's trulyriveting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree. Personally, I was<n>very pleased
with the way this volume<n>incorporated aspects of
real-world<n>mythology.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's important to note that it delves into<n>rather
realistic concepts, despite being a<n>work of fiction.
The training methods are<n>quite feasible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive at the library to find Zenno Rob<n>Roy,
Mejiro Ardan, and Biwa Hayahide<n>having a
discussion in hushed tones.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello. I'm sorry—were we being too<n>loud?
choice_data_list: Not at all. What are you talking about?
Not at all. What are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We're sharing our impressions of the<n>latest
volume in this novel series. It's a<n>very intriguing
book...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's simply amazing! I could talk about itforever!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's a slight problem however. There<n>aren't
many others with whom we can<n>discuss the latest
volume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That's... absolutely correct. We've found<n>
ourselves unable to fully express all the<n>passion
we feel towards this book.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's such a shame...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the book's a hidden gem? In that<n>case, I
can see why they'd feel<n>disheartened about not
having enough<n>people to discuss it with.
choice_data_list: I think I'll try reading it too.
I think I'll try reading it too.

Can you tell me what makes it such a fantastic
read?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the book's a hidden gem? In that<n>case, I
can see why they'd feel<n>disheartened about not
having enough<n>people to discuss it with.
choice_data_list: I think I'll try reading it too.
I think I'll try reading it too.

Can you tell me what makes it such a fantastic
read?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of their eyes seem to light up at that<n>instant.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Y-you really mean it?! I'm so happy to<n>hear that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Your thoughtfulness is much<n>appreciated. Hehe,
how wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I believe this library has every volume in<n>the
series. I'll fetch them right away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, even Hayahide is enthused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three Umamusume are delighted by<n>my
decision. They really are passionate<n>about books.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having the opportunity to assist them<n>fills my own
heart with joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though for some reason, I can't help but<n>feel this
joy might be short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...And that's volume thirty-four. This is<n>the entire
series of books, including the<n>latest volume.
choice_data_list: How can there be so many?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In front of Hayahide looms what can<n>only be
described as a mountain of<n>books!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's also a spin-off series that<n>comprises
twelve volumes. I'll go and<n>retrieve those, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait, Hayahide. Could you bring<n>along the
series guide as well?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wow, volume six brings back so many<n>memories! I
loved the hero's training arc!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should read all the previous<n>volumes
again. I might discover new<n>details or gain a
different perspective on<n>things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of this series, but I had no<n>idea how
insanely long it is.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I think you've caught on. There<n>aren't
many people to discuss the latest<n>volume with
because so few people have<n>read all of the
previous ones.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wonder if this is too much to ask of<n>you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm so thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My pride as a trainer keeps me from<n>backing
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd walk through fire if it meant putting a<n>smile on
a student's face!
choice_data_list:
(Time to surmount the towering mountain
before me!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not a problem! Are you interested in<n>reading
the series?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew. We need to dig deep and sell<n>Trainer on
the books' strong points.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The trio begin their pitch in a somewhat<n>
exuberant manner.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This series follows a protagonist who has<n>no
special powers on their journey to<n>becoming a
hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The depth of the history and<n>world-building in
these novels is such<n>that reading them is like
poring over the<n>annals of an entire world.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The protagonist is so quick-witted that<n>you end
up impressed with how realistic<n>and logical the
novels are, especially for<n>a fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They continue discussing the novels with<n>palpable
glee.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing them so happy fills my own heart<n>with joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though for some reason, I can't help but<n>feel this
joy might be short-lived...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And what's more! The series has a wealth<n>of
foreshadowing! The story is so<n>painstakingly
crafted!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
There are events in volume thirty-two<n>that were
hinted at as far back as<n>volume three! Nobody
even realized it<n>was foreshadowing at the time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I can't go into any more detail<n>lest I spoil
something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Many of the events borrow heavily from<n>
real-world mythology, so the ideas<n>presented in
the series are truly worthy<n>of analysis.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The motifs and symbolism that appear in<n>the tales
of past events often play into<n>future
developments in the story, so it's<n>also fascinating
from a historical point of<n>view.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I can't go into any more detail<n>without
spoiling things.
choice_data_list: (Such fiery passion! I think I might get singed!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More than an hour has passed, but none<n>of them
are showing any signs of slowing<n>down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I gravely underestimated their fervor for<n>these
books!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, please read up to<n>volume eight.
Its unique depiction of the<n>laws of physics within
a fantasy world is<n>truly brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I can't go into any more detail or I'll<n>spoil it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, come to think of it, the protagonist's<n>
perspective on the idea of being a hero<n>in volume
twelve is very compelling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The way volume twenty-one examined<n>the
historical motifs it depicted was<n>strikingly
innovative.

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy & Ardan
text_block_list.text: You will?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was the only response I could<n>possibly give...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If it's to put a smile on a student's face,<n>then no
task is too demanding for any<n>trainer worth their
salt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no choice but to dive right into<n>the fiery
embrace of their ardent<n>passion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I stay up late reading everynight for a very lengthy period.
